Batch 16 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 16 resolves 16 classic radio broadcasts and mystery dramas: 6 syndicated Hollywood productions of C.P. MacGregor's Heartbeat Theatre (produced for The Salvation Army), 7 syndicated radio detective cases from Ellery Queen's Minute Mysteries (1965 master syndication series), and 3 Marine Corps recruitment broadcasts of The Bob Crosby Show (featuring Bob Crosby and his Bob Cats with guest Eileen Barton).

1. Heartbeat Theatre — C.P. MacGregor Hollywood Productions Dated

Hosted and produced by C.P. MacGregor from Hollywood for The Salvation Army:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate Dramatic Arc
Heartbeat_Theatre_Fourth_Of_July.mp3 "Fourth of July Reunion" 1962-07-01 Independence Day holiday family reconciliation drama.
Heartbeat_Theatre_72nd_Christmas.mp3 "The Seventy-Second Christmas of Charlie Snow" 1961-12-24 Holiday drama of an elderly craftsman discovering renewed community hope.
Heartbeat_Theatre_Last_Time_Lulu.mp3 "The Last Time I Saw Lulu" 1963-04-14 Springtime community drama on redemption and second chances.
Heartbeat_Theatre_Birthday_Surprise.mp3 "Birthday Surprise" 1962-09-23 A surprise celebration uncovers long-kept family devotion.
Heartbeat_Theatre_A_Day_To_Remember.mp3 "A Day to Remember" 1961-05-14 Mother's Day special broadcast on selfless parental love.
Heartbeat_Theatre_The_Broken_Promise.mp3 "The Broken Promise" 1961-06-18 Father's Day drama confronting broken commitments and healing.
